apiBase.description: Open API host. Dida365 (滴答清单): https://api.dida365.com. TickTick (international): https://api.ticktick.com.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone in which times are read and shown (e.g. Asia/Shanghai). Default: the daemon's time zone.

defaultProjectId.description: Project that new tasks go to when the assistant names none. Default: the inbox.

toolsets.description: Groups of tools offered to the assistant. Leave some out to keep the tool list short.

maxResults.description: Most entries a listing returns to the model; a tool call may ask for fewer.

timeoutSec.description: Time allowed per request to Dida365.

reminders.description: Events for tasks that reach their time. Off by default.

intervalMin.description: How often open tasks are checked.

leadMin.description: Report a timed task this many minutes before its time.

dailyAt.description: Time of day (in timeZone) at which the day's all-day tasks and the overdue summary are reported.

overdue.description: Report once a day which tasks from earlier days are still open.

level.description: 2: delivered at once; 3: a debounced batch; 4: rides along with other events.

projectIds.description: Only watch these projects. Default: all.
